scoring_justification: The output contract only requires the final computed numbers; no raw computational trace is submitted, so a full recompute from raw artifacts is infeasible. We compare the agent's reported numbers to the paper-verified gold values with tolerances appropriate for a recompute spread.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for delta0, a0, and growth time
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: 'supersaturation level is ~0.1', 'maximum radius a0≈0.38 µm', 'grow to 0.9a0 over 123 µsec'
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly extracted from the paper's reported experimental quantification.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own headline results; the task is to reproduce them.

outputs.description: Computed supersaturation δ₀⁰ for the clouding scenario.
Maximum droplet radius a₀ achievable under the given supersaturation.
Droplet growth time to 0.9 of the maximum radius.

output_contract.notes: All three quantities are numerically recomputed by the hidden checker using the paper's analytical expressions with a gold reference set of constants and input parameters. The agent must implement the three formulas and output the numerical results. Scattering cross-section and optical thickness are omitted as they require additional Mie theory parameters not fully specified.
